# API — `webhooks`

Source: `apps/api/src/routes/v1/webhooks.routes.ts`

> Where payment providers tell us what happened. ⚠️ MOUNTED BEFORE `express.json()` IN app.ts, AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING. Every provider signs the exact bytes it sent. `express.json()` consumes the request stream and hands on a parsed object; re-serialising it reorders keys and changes whitespace, so the HMAC no longer matches and every delivery fails verification for a reason that looks exactly like a wrong secret. So this router owns its own body parser — `express.raw()` — and it must stay ahead of the global one. Moving it below `app.use(express.json())` breaks payments silently, in production only, and the symptom is "webhooks stopped working" with no error anywhere. NO TENANT, NO SESSION,…
